entries.title: Romans 11:1
segments: Then I ask, Did God cast off his people? No indeed. For I also am an Israelite, a son of Abraham, a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

entries.title: Romans 11:2
segments: God did not cast off his people whom he foreknew. For do you not know what is said in the Scripture about Elijah? how he pleaded with God against Israel, saying,

entries.title: Romans 11:3
segments: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, they have overthrown thine altars; And now I alone am left, and they seek my life.

entries.title: Romans 11:4
segments: But what was the answer of God to him? I have reserved for myself seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal.

entries.title: Romans 11:5
segments: In the same way also at this time there is a remnant chosen by gift of grace.

entries.title: Romans 11:6
segments: But if it is by grace, it is no longer of works; or else grace is no more grace.

entries.title: Romans 11:7
segments: What then? that which Israel has been seeking for, that he has not obtained; but the chosen have obtained it, and the rest have been hardened.

entries.title: Romans 11:8
segments: According as it is written, God has given them a spirit of slumber, Eyes that they should not see, Ears that they should not hear, unto this day.

entries.title: Romans 11:9
segments: As David says: Let their table be made a snare and a trap, And a stumbling-block and a recompense unto them;

entries.title: Romans 11:10
segments: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, And bow thou down their backs forever.

entries.title: Romans 11:11
segments: I ask then, "Have they stumbled so as to fall?" No indeed; but by their lapse salvation has come unto Gentiles, "to provoke Israel to jealousy."

entries.title: Romans 11:12
segments: Now if their stumbling enriches the world, and their loss enriches the Gentiles, how much more must their fulness do!

entries.title: Romans 11:13
segments: For to you who are Gentiles I say that since I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

entries.title: Romans 11:14
segments: if by any means I might "provoke to jealousy" my kinsmen, and save some among them.

entries.title: Romans 11:15
segments: For if their casting out is the reconciliation of the world to God, what will their restoration be but life out of death?

entries.title: Romans 11:16
segments: Now if the first-fruits of the dough [Abraham and the Patriarchs] are holy, so also is the whole mass [their descendants]. And if the root of a tree [Abraham] is holy, so also are the branches [his descendants].

entries.title: Romans 11:17
segments: Supposing that some of the branches have been broken off, and you, although you were but a wild olive, have been grafted in among the branches and have become a partaker with them of the fatness of the olive tree, do not glory over the branches;

entries.title: Romans 11:18
segments: or if you are glorying, remember that it is not you who uphold the root, but the root which upholds you.

entries.title: Romans 11:19
segments: "Branches have been broken off," you say, "that I might be grafted in."

entries.title: Romans 11:20
segments: True, through their unbelief they were broken off, and by your faith you stand. Do not be puffed up, but fear;

entries.title: Romans 11:21
segments: for if God spared not the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

entries.title: Romans 11:22
segments: Fix your gaze, therefore, on the goodness and the severity of God; towards those who fell, severity, but towards you, God's goodness, if you continue stedfast in his goodness; otherwise you, too, will be cut off.

entries.title: Romans 11:23
segments: And they also [those Jews], if they do not continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in again; for God is able to graft them in again.

entries.title: Romans 11:24
segments: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a mere wild olive tree, and have been grafted, contrary to nature, into a fruitful olive tree, how much more shall these, the natural branches, be regrafted into their own olive tree?

entries.title: Romans 11:25
segments: For I would not, my brothers, have you ignorant of this hidden truth, for fear that you become wise in your own conceits: that a hardening in part has befallen Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles is come in.

entries.title: Romans 11:26
segments: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: The deliver will come from Zion, He will banish all ungodliness from Jacob;

entries.title: Romans 11:27
segments: This is my covenant with them, When I shall take away their sins.

entries.title: Romans 11:28
segments: In relation to the gospel, the Jews are God's enemies for your sake; but in relation to the election, they are dearly loved for their forefather's sake.

entries.title: Romans 11:29
segments: For no change of purpose can annul God's free gift and call.

entries.title: Romans 11:30
segments: And as in times past you were yourselves disobedient to God, but now, thanks to their disobedience, have obtained mercy;

entries.title: Romans 11:31
segments: even so they also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they also may now obtain mercy.

entries.title: Romans 11:32
segments: For God has locked up all in the prison of disobedience, that upon all he may have mercy.

entries.title: Romans 11:33
segments: Oh, the depths of the riches, both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unfathomable are his judgments, and how unsearchable his paths!

entries.title: Romans 11:34
segments: Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counsellor?

entries.title: Romans 11:35
segments: Who has first given to Him, So as to receive payment in return?

entries.title: Romans 11:36
segments: For of him and through him, and for him, are all things. All glory to him forever and ever! Amen.
